fe3o4_pda.notes: PDA is pH-responsive; published Fe3O4@PDA shows strong PS release at extreme pH.

chitosan_fe3o4_tio2_microalgae.notes: Multi-component microrobot with Fe3O4/TiO2, chitosan and microalgae; nanoparticle fate remains an uncertainty.

fe3o4_mil101cr.notes: Chromium-bearing MOF receives an explicit material-hazard prior despite strong adsorption evidence.

stearic_magnetic_biochar.notes: Magnetic biochar with hydrophobic surface modification; reuse evidence remains sparse.

fe3o4_carbon_black_fatty_acids.notes: Real washing-machine effluent evidence exists, but carbon-black and coating mass balance remain open.

interpretation.predicted_removal_pct: surrogate estimate anchored to published maximum removal; not a measured result
interpretation.magnetic_recovery_proxy: dimensionless recovery proxy; not a measured capture fraction
interpretation.cycle10_retention_proxy: extrapolated durability proxy; not a measured ten-cycle result unless future evidence exists
interpretation.release_risk_proxy: relative risk-screening proxy; not a toxicology result
